Danh sách API / Web Service

Danh sách API:

STT

Method

Full URL

Ghi chú

1

GET

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/technology/tree

Cây công nghệ/thư viện, phân trang. Query: tech, systemIds, rootElementId, levels, page, pageSize. Scope technology:view-list
TKCT: TECH-API-001

2

GET

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/technology/tree/children

Dòng con của node (lazy load). Query: parentId, parentLevel, levels, tech, systemIds, rootElementId. Scope technology:view-list
TKCT: TECH-API-002

3

GET

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/technology/node/labels

Toàn bộ công nghệ/thư viện của một node. Query: kind, nodeId, nodeLevel, tech, systemIds, rootElementId. Scope technology:view-list
TKCT: TECH-API-006

4

GET

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/technology/suggest

Gợi ý công nghệ + phiên bản. Query: search, limit. Scope technology:view-list
TKCT: TECH-API-003

5

GET

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/technology/tree/export

Xuất CSV (UTF-8 BOM). Query: tech, systemIds, rootElementId, levels. Scope technology:export
TKCT: TECH-API-004

6

GET

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/technology/elements/:id/summary

Số đếm công nghệ/thư viện của element. Path: id (UUID v4). Scope technology:view-list
TKCT: TECH-API-005

7

POST

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/deployments

Tạo deployment. Body JSON: nameDisplay, clusterName, namespace, gitRepo, branch, jenkinsInfo, elementId. Scope deployments:create
TKCT: DHTD-DEP-005

8

POST

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/deployments/:id/container

Gán deployment vào container. Path: id (UUID v4). Body: containerId. Scope deployments:edit
TKCT: DHTD-DEP-003

9

DELETE

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/deployments/:id/container

Gỡ liên kết deployment khỏi container. Path: id (UUID v4). Scope deployments:edit
TKCT: DHTD-DEP-004

10

DELETE

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/deployments/:id

Xóa mềm deployment. Path: id (UUID v4). Scope deployments:delete
TKCT: DHTD-DEP-006

11

PATCH

https://dac.tanzu-dev.mbbank.com.vn/data-hub-api-dev/v1.0/deployments/:id

Sửa một phần deployment. Path: id (UUID v4). Body JSON: gitRepo, branch, jenkinsInfo. Scope deployments:edit
TKCT: DHTD-DEP-007
